description_en: Removes a cloud service from Web Application Firewall (WAF). This operation currently supports only Elastic Compute Service (ECS) and Classic Load Balancer (CLB)
description_zh: 取消云产品接入，当前仅支持ECS和CLB
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi delete-cloud-resource --instance-id waf_v2_public_cn-000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteCloudResource

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to view the ID of your WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html，查看当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the cloud service. Valid values:

clb4: Layer 4 CLB.

clb7: Layer 7 CLB.

ecs: ECS.

nlb: Network Load Balancer (NLB)
parameters.help_zh:
云产品类型。取值：

clb4：表示四层CLB产品。

clb7：表示七层CLB产品。

ecs：表示ECS产品。
nlb：表示NLB产品
parameters.name: resource_product

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud service instance
parameters.name: resource_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The port of the cloud service that is added to WAF
parameters.name: port

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the protected resource. WAF automatically generates this ID when you add the cloud service to WAF.

Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2839876.html to add a resource and then view the resource ID in the response
parameters.help_zh:
已接入的资源ID，云产品接入时由WAF自动生成。

您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2839876.html接入资源后，查看响应中的资源ID
parameters.name: cloud_resource_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique ID for each request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
